adaptation_policy: Do not require Go for build, test, validation, or migration gates.
Do not require CMake in default competition gates; use Cargo, Python, gcc/g++, and GNU Make paths.
Keep Rust code compatible with stable Rust 1.96.0 and avoid nightly-only features.
Use Python 3.12-compatible scripts and avoid dependencies that require a newer Python runtime.
Use Node/npm scripts compatible with Node v24.13.0 and npm 11.6.2.
Use the configured Huawei mirrors for package-manager access in competition jobs.
Record this profile id and environment.json hash in generated validation evidence when a run is performed in the competition environment.
